summary: One sprint since server-v0.16.0 (milestone 71). The guided career interview's text version: DraftLoop proposes topics the career record leaves untold, such as roles without an outcome, untold periods and themes, and skills target applications ask for (#2174). A coach-style interviewer, checked against the career interview method guide, talks one topic through at a time (#2188, #2176). Sessions are stored and resumable (#2175), and a summary becomes transcript evidence only once the candidate confirms it, with the tier they pick (#2177). The API serves it under /v1/workspaces/:id/career-interview (#2178), and the Career evidence page shows it (#2189). A capped walk on Claude Sonnet 5.5 cost US$0.035 (#2179).
knownLimitations: The interview needs content screening in rules+model mode, because it uses that route to reach Claude, and recorded consent to send career material to Anthropic. The web shows it in owner-token mode only. Differences from the record are flagged only for role topics. No draft run has yet been shown citing a confirmed summary. Voice input comes in a later sprint.
